card.name: Sudden death reports in stimulant warnings
card.fires_on: The word "Sudden" (after S) or the linking word "in"/"of" right after "Sudden death has been reported" or "Postmarketing cases", in warning sections on cardiac risk.

modes.label: Link after reported
modes.description: The word "in" right after "has been reported" in sudden-death warnings.
modes.example: Sudden death has been reported<< in>> pediatric patients with structural cardiac abnormalities and other

modes.label: Inside the word Sudden
modes.description: The "udden" part of "Sudden" at the start of a sudden-death heading or sentence.
modes.example: 5.2 Risks to Patients with Serious Cardiac Disease S<<udden>> death has been reported in patients with structural

modes.label: Other warning links
modes.description: Small linking words in other risk statements, such as "of" after postmarketing cases.
modes.example: 5.2 Gastrointestinal Obstruction Postmarketing cases<< of>> bowel obstruction have occurred with colesevel
